unblockedCandidates.matchingEvidence: Same scene, two dogs, Eric 79 / Tina 100 HUD. Mean absolute RGB difference 1.84/1.76/1.99 per 255 after resizing prior capture to the public IGDB image. Different compression/size, not byte-identical.
unblockedCandidates.visuallyObserved: Both canine silhouettes extend from full heads to tapered tails within the frame. Across the two poses, limbs and paws are visible. Dark charcoal body, pale grey-beige bindings along head, shoulders, spine and flanks; long muzzle, small canine paws and thin tapered tail. One body per creature; split jaw must not become two complete heads.

notUnblocked.finding: The native OBJ includes out_hair groups extending roughly to Y3028 versus core body Y88.7. This bind-pose export does not establish a useful finite native silhouette or its animated deformation. No hair truncation, scaling or omission authorized; reference blocker preserved.
